base_order: Generate A then B; use float32 host source; quantize both once to BF16 before any arm or reference.
baseline: A has shape (M,K), B (K,N); Gaussian A divided by sqrt(K), B standard normal.
failure_policy: Nonfinite generated inputs produce explicit input_error records; do not replace the seed or rescale silently.

cancellation.construction: A[:,:h]=a_left; A[:,h:2*h]=a_left+a_delta; B[:h,:]=b_top; B[h:2*h,:]=-b_top. For odd K, set final A column and B row to zero.
cancellation.note: Near cancellation of halves, with a small perturbation representable after BF16 rounding; exact loss of some deltas during quantization is part of the specified input.

log_scale.a_scale: Independent per-K-column integer powers 2**e, e uniform from -8 through 8 inclusive
log_scale.b_scale: Independent per-K-row integer powers 2**e, e uniform from -8 through 8 inclusive
log_scale.generation_order: Generate base A, base B, then A exponents, then B exponents; broadcast scales along M and N respectively.

outliers.generation_order: Generate base A, base B, then independent Bernoulli masks for A then B; multiply masked elements by 128.

stream_contract: Hash generator source in each run. Any implementation change produces a new source snapshot; comparisons use identical generated arrays within a case. Never compare different profile implementations as if inputs were identical.
